sql: SELECT notice_id, section_id, organization_id, name, raw_identifier, country FROM organization_mentions WHERE notice_id IN (46869506,46869190,46869201,46825577,46868893,46730362,46796184,46758503,46920273,46988113,46761819,47260436) LIMIT 100

SELECT notice_id, section_id, field_id, substr(value,1,400) AS v FROM notice_texts WHERE notice_id IN (46730362,46796184,46869506,46910644,46988113) AND field_id IN ('title','description','BT-21-Procedure','BT-21-Lot','BT-24-Procedure','BT-24-Lot') LIMIT 40

SELECT id, identifier, name, provisional FROM organizations WHERE country = 'GB' AND identifier_kind = 'national' AND identifier IN ('GBCHC1088835','GBCHC216250','GBMPR19341R','GBMPR30301R','GBUKPRN10007788','GBCHC1073926','GBCHC1179376','GBCHC518610','GBMPR26511R','GBCHCREGISTEREDCHARITYNO1088835','GBCHCCHARITYNUMBER216250','GBMPRIP19341R','GBMPRIP30301R','GBUKPRNUKPRN10007788','GBCHCCHARITYNO1073926','GBCHCCHARITYNUMBER1179376','GBCHCCHARITYNUMBER518610','GBMPRIP26511R') LIMIT 60
